a: A {Trash} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash.
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.
The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

However, if you use this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect to digivolve that Digimon before activating EX10-009 [Creepymon]'s [When Attacking] effect, you won't be able to activate that [When Attacking] effect.
Card Q&A.q: When my EX10-009 [Creepymon] attacks, in what order do that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect and this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect activate?

a: You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After this card is placed on top of the attacking Digimon and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you then trash an opponent's security card.

Is the "by" condition in this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect met even if I don't have a card in my deck and can't perform a digivolution bonus draw when using this effect to digivolve?

a: You can only activate this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect if it's already in the trash upon the timing when you make the attack declaration for your [Creepymon].

If this card is placed in the trash by an effect that activates after making the attack declaration for your [Creepymon], this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect won't trigger and you can't activate it.

Effect: {Trash} [Your Turn] When one of your [Creepymon] attacks, if your opponent has 10 or more cards in their trash, by digivolving it into this card without paying the cost, trash your opponent's top security card.

[When Digivolving] Delete all of your opponent's lowest level Digimon. Then, you may play up to 4 play cost's total worth of [Evil] or [Fallen Angel] trait cards from your trash without paying the cost. For every 10 cards in your opponent's trash, add 4 to this effect's play cost maximum.
